query: SELECT series.name AS school_series, 'lesson' AS resource_type, l.title, l.is_active, NULL::boolean AS is_published, length(coalesce(l.content, '')) AS content_length, 0 AS question_count FROM lessons l JOIN chapters c ON c.id = l.chapter_id JOIN course_subject_offerings o ON o.id = c.subject_offering_id JOIN series ON series.id = o.series_id WHERE l.id IN ('fe364cab-7eac-4d14-9c6f-ee279cc92750', 'dac94865-5803-4ae6-b241-c9a2844633ae') UNION ALL SELECT series.name, 'exercise', e.title, e.is_active, e.is_published, length(coalesce(e.content_markdown, '') || coalesce(e.correction_markdown, '')), (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM exercise_questions eq WHERE eq.exercise_id = e.id) FROM exercises e JOIN series ON series.id = e.series_id WHERE e.lesson_id IN ('fe364cab-7eac-4d14-9c6f-ee279cc92750', 'dac94865-5803-4ae6-b241-c9a2844633ae') UNION ALL SELECT series.name, 'quiz', q.title, q.is_active, q.is_published, length(coalesce(q.description, '')), (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM quiz_questions qq WHERE qq.quiz_id = q.id) FROM quizzes q JOIN series ON series.id = q.series_id WHERE q.lesson_id IN ('fe364cab-7eac-4d14-9c6f-ee279cc92750', 'dac94865-5803-4ae6-b241-c9a2844633ae') ORDER BY school_series, resource_type, title LIMIT 50;
